base: liquid white on the top and liquid black on the bottom, wet and slick

steps.subject: sky
steps.action: criss-cross tiny blue sky in the top corner
steps.load: tiny bit of phthalo blue

steps.subject: cloud
steps.action: tap a big strong cloud with the corner
steps.load: tap firmly with very little paint
steps.rule: a simple tap makes a cloud without much work

steps.subject: cloud
steps.action: blend the sky and cloud together
steps.load: clean dry brush

steps.subject: sun/glow
steps.action: tap small sunlight spots in the clouds
steps.load: small amount on the brush

steps.subject: sun/glow
steps.action: soften the sunlight spots with the blender
steps.load: clean blender

steps.subject: mountain
steps.action: load and push the dark mountain mix
steps.load: dark mix, mostly black

steps.subject: mountain
steps.action: slide wet mountain paint around with the 2in
steps.load: liquid white and black on the brush
steps.rule: wet paint moves easily so it can go anywhere

steps.subject: mountain
steps.action: knife a light ridge on the mountain
steps.load: white greyed with a little black and bright red
steps.rule: light from the left decides where the ridge goes

steps.subject: mountain
steps.action: knife shadow color onto the mountain
steps.load: white and blue with a little black

steps.subject: mountain
steps.action: blend highlights and shadows together
steps.load: clean blender

steps.subject: leaf tree
steps.action: tap basic tree shapes with the corner
steps.load: mountain mix with sap green added

steps.subject: other: bottom shadow
steps.action: blend a little bluish tone up from the bottom
steps.load: a little prussian blue in the black
steps.motion: start at the bottom and blend upward

steps.subject: trunk/limbs
steps.action: tap thin trunk and limb marks
steps.load: dark sienna with a little white, thinned
steps.where: scattered in the trees, lighter on the left
steps.rule: thin paint sticks over thick paint so it goes on top

steps.subject: leaf tree
steps.action: tap yellow-green foliage above the dark
steps.load: dirty brush touched into yellow
steps.where: above the dark area of the trees
steps.rule: the black and blue on the brush turn yellow into green

steps.subject: bush
steps.action: tap individual bushes with ochre and red
steps.load: yellow ochre with a touch of bright red
steps.rule: a touch of red changes the flavor

steps.subject: leaf tree
steps.action: darken lower bushes with thinned paint
steps.load: palette mix thinned with paint thinner
steps.motion: tap downward and darker toward the base
steps.rule: thinner makes the paint go on more easily

steps.subject: evergreen
steps.action: tap evergreen trees with the fan
steps.load: dark evergreen mix loaded full

steps.subject: evergreen
steps.action: add a big evergreen over the mountain with thinner
steps.load: dark mix with paint thinner in the corner
steps.rule: thin paint slides over thick paint without mixing

steps.subject: trunk/limbs
steps.action: indicate tree trunks with white and brown
steps.load: white with van dyke and dark sienna

steps.subject: evergreen
steps.action: highlight the left side of the evergreens
steps.load: a little yellow ochre and cad yellow
steps.rule: light source on left, hence emphasis on left side

steps.subject: rock
steps.action: add rocks and dirt with brown
steps.load: brown on the knife
steps.motion: pull small dirt and rock shapes

steps.subject: land
steps.action: pull a lighter brown and white bank down
steps.load: lighter brown and white on the knife

steps.subject: bush
steps.action: pop in bushes pushing upward with the fan
steps.load: greens left on the fan

steps.subject: rock
steps.action: paint thin dark and light stones with the filbert
steps.load: thin dark on both sides, lighter brown on one side
steps.motion: pull one side through lighter color

steps.subject: water
steps.action: pull dark water down with a touch of white
steps.load: a little white on the 2in brush

steps.subject: water line
steps.action: touch a thick blue and white line along the water
steps.load: thick blue and white on the knife

steps.subject: mountain
steps.action: add a dark projection on the mountain side
steps.load: leftover dark mix
steps.rule: dark behind lets the light show up

steps.subject: bush
steps.action: tap bush shapes following the angles
steps.load: sap green with a little yellow ochre

steps.subject: water line
steps.action: draw a water line with blue and white
steps.load: blue and white on the knife

steps.subject: rock
steps.action: paint a rock with the filbert in one stroke
steps.load: brown and white on the filbert
steps.where: one spot off to the side

steps.subject: other: signature
steps.action: sign the painting
steps.load: bright red with paint thinner
